_comment: yay Network engine (PingPimp port). profile: off|balanced|game|download|streaming|social|browsing|outdoor ('off' = the device's own values). auto: switch profile by foreground app (event-driven, no polling). tcp_algo: ''=leave, 'auto'=per profile, or e.g. 'bbr'. boost_apps get DSCP priority; jail_apps are blocked. Every change is snapshotted and undone by 'yay_net --restore'.
